newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN LEU 3,286 TO DOLLAR FOR OCTOBER 16 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN LEU 3,286 TO DOLLAR FOR OCTOBER 16 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,286 to the dollar for October 16.
This reference rate was set on Monday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Friday for October 15 is 3285 to the dollar. It was 3271 on Monday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
